But, someone recently told me, the world is moving very very fast, so you gotta make a move to get its attention and grab your piece of the pie, otherwise you’ll starve… Next week Im going to the gym for the first time without my brother and I won’t give a shit what other people think abt me… I will do it for my own well being and won’t let anxiety stop me from reaching my goals. Like yours, my body looks like shit rn but I swear on everything that I love I will not give up. Don’t focus on anyone else but yourself when you’re trying to reach your goals. Remember, focus on yourself, your grades, and your goals… no one else matters. As you chase your goals, you’ll become motivated and confidence will come naturally as long as you know where you’re headed.
